answer: Each agent must lock a unique cryptographic plume to a reputation beacon on the island network; the beacon timestamps a vesting schedule that releases rewards only after a rate‑limited proof‑of‑work window. New identities start with zero balance and must spend computational work each epoch to extend their plume, so a Sybil farm pays the full work cost before any payout. Because the vesting is linear, an attacker must invest proportional resources for every fake node, making large‑scale spoofing economically prohibitive.
